name: Paysign, Inc.
summary: Paysign, Inc. provides prepaid card programs, patient affordability offerings, digital banking, life science software technology solutions, and integrated payment processing services for businesses, consumers, and government institutions in the United States. The company offers solutions for corporate rewards, prepaid gift cards, general-purpose reloadable debit cards, employee incentives, consumer rebates, donor compensation, clinical trials, healthcare reimbursement payments and pharmaceutical payment assistance, and demand deposit accounts accessible with a debit card and software solutions.
